name: youtoba
description: A small, beautiful native shell around YouTube — Desktop/TV toggle, ads stripped at the source.

scripts.icons: rm -rf build/icon.iconset && swift build/make-icons.swift build/icon.iconset && cp build/icon.iconset/iconTemplate.png build/icon.iconset/iconTemplate@2x.png assets/ && rm build/icon.iconset/iconTemplate.png build/icon.iconset/iconTemplate@2x.png && iconutil -c icns build/icon.iconset -o assets/icon.icns
scripts.pack: electron-builder --mac dmg zip && npm run sign
scripts.sign: APP=$(find dist -maxdepth 2 -type d -name 'YouTOBA.app' | head -1) && xattr -cr "$APP" && codesign --force --deep --sign - "$APP" && codesign --verify --verbose "$APP"
scripts.deploy: APP=$(find dist -maxdepth 2 -type d -name 'YouTOBA.app' | head -1) && rm -rf /Applications/YouTOBA.app && cp -R "$APP" /Applications/ && echo 'Deployed YouTOBA.app to /Applications'
